hypothesis: Training only the 24,768-parameter zero-init Helmholtz residual head will improve independent Marmousi source confirmation by at least 20% over fixed P_bg without the calibration degradation caused by all-parameter r29 training.
expected_mechanism: Frozen source/medium features prevent the three fit records from rewriting the representation; the small linear spatial readout can learn only a shared scattering correction and defaults to P_bg when no useful direction exists.

single_conceptual_variable.name: trainable_scope
single_conceptual_variable.held_constant: P_bg, panels, parent, residual target, learning rate, updates, seed and metric

primary_metric: all-saved confirmation relative L2 versus P_bg baseline
failure_signal: Reject if confirmation improves less than 20%, fit/calibration regresses over 5%, trainable scope drifts, or any non-finite/OOM/cache/binding failure occurs.
rollback: Preserve P_bg, r29 and r31; do not tune validation/test_id.
